component.name: Beaver Notes
component.summary: The local-first open-source Workspace for people and teams

description.p: The local-first open-source Workspace for people and teams. Our mission is to give our users the perfect balance of simplicity, privacy, and productivity. Made with love ❤️ in 🇪🇺!

ul.li: Markdown support for rich text formatting

description.p: Beaver Notes 5.0.0 is a complete rewrite from Electron to Tauri, with a lighter, faster app and a single codebase across desktop and mobile.

ul.li: New SQLite-backed storage foundation with app-wide encryption.
Redesigned onboarding, home, sidebar, editor, folders, labels, and settings.
Improved import and export, including Beaver Notes 4, Apple Notes, Notion, Evernote, Bear, Obsidian, Simplenote, and Markdown.
Added backlinks, reader mode, word count and goal, text alignment, tables, and richer editor blocks.
Improved Beaver Sync integration, encrypted asset sync, and folder-based sync reliability.
Added iOS and Android support with a unified codebase.
Improved RTL support, note previews, command palette, and mobile bullet lists.

description.p: Note: Beaver Sync will not be publicly available until January 2027 due to pending payment-provider approval.
